# Third-party Protobuf sources

## `buf/validate/validate.proto`

Vendored from [protovalidate](https://github.com/bufbuild/protovalidate) at:

`proto/protovalidate/buf/validate/validate.proto` on the `main` branch.

Update this file when upgrading `buf.build/go/protovalidate` in consuming services so descriptor options stay compatible with the runtime library.
